lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across multiple tests, triggering guardrail rollbacks.
Finish screen layout changes consistently degraded performance, causing negative impacts and rollbacks.
Sign-in hints and adoption new screens proved helpful, driving multiple winning tests.
Home wait-info features mostly showed no clear effect across repeated tests, despite driving two winning tests.
Evidence remains mixed for adoption and choose-path redesigns, which yielded both significant wins and major losses.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes and underestimated the gains of winning tests.

candidates.title: new_pet_preview_style_screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before certificate creation that displays animated previews of the pet style.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results, leading to adoption drop-off.

new_pet_style_preview.headline: Preview Pet Animations
new_pet_style_preview.body: Review how your pet will look and move on your desktop before signing the certificate.

guard.reason: Adding a pet style preview screen inside onboarding is permitted and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step drops 25.5%, but adding new screens historically shows -0.5% average lift.

candidates.title: choose_path_carousel_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into a full carousel showing path benefits side-by-side.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion during path selection.

choose_path.headline: Explore Your Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Swipe to compare custom pet creation against adopting pre-made companions.

guard.reason: The carousel redesign continues to offer both custom pet creation and adoption of pre-made pets.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesigns historically hurt conversion (-1.6%) and median time is only 8s.

candidates.title: upload_photos_interactive_preview_new_flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive validation photo flow on the photo upload screen with immediate preview feedback.
candidates.why: Custom pet rendering issues caused support tickets and drop-off during the adoption stage.

upload_photos.headline: Check Photo Compatibility
upload_photos.body: Confirm feature alignment to guarantee accurate desktop pet rendering.

guard.reason: Adding photo compatibility checklist and preview components on the photo upload screen is valid.

candidates.score_note: New flows on adoption show strong historic negative performance (-4.4%) despite support evidence.

candidates.title: sign_in_split_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild sign-in screen into a split layout separating cloud backup benefits from authentication options.
candidates.why: 8 emails reported pets missing or reset after re-authenticating, showing account confusion on sign-in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet
sign_in.body: Connect your account to sync pet progress and prevent pet data loss across sessions.

guard.reason: Redesigning the sign-in layout within onboarding is allowed and maintains authentication functionality.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in redesigns consistently hurt performance (-2.5%) and risk triggering rollbacks.

candidates.title: sign_in_existing_pet_recovery_hint
candidates.change: Add a prominent hint explaining that signing into a previous account restores saved pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited lost pets after signing in again, making account recovery assurance essential.

sign_in.hint: Logging into your original account automatically retrieves existing pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory hint on sign-in regarding pet recovery is valid and fair.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between support emails and proven historical success for sign-in hints (+1.7%).

candidates.title: waiting_desktop_render_status_hint
candidates.change: Show estimated rendering time and display tips while waiting for the pet to land on desktop.
candidates.why: 3 emails mentioned pets failing to show on desktop, while home step wait mean is 2336 seconds.

waiting.hint: Please keep the app open in background while desktop render assets assemble.

guard.reason: Showing time estimates and render status on the waiting screen for a real waiting period is permitted.

candidates.score_note: High average wait time supported by emails, but historical wait info changes showed inconsistent results.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_summon_guide_hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint detailing hotkeys and right-click actions for controlling the pet.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.hint: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open controls, toggle visibility, or start chat.

guard.reason: Adding desktop controls guidance to the home intro screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has highest drop-off (35.2%), but hints on finish step historically underperform (-1.2%).

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_badge_display_incentive
candidates.change: Add a companion badge component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate adoption completion.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 74.5% conversion rate; adding visual reward elements can reduce completion drop-off.

guard.reason: Replacing the certificate components with a playful badge loses the required official stamp feature.

candidates.title: story_quick_overview_journey_hint
candidates.change: Include a setup time expectation hint on the story welcome screen.
candidates.why: Users spend up to 514s mean time on choose_path due to lack of initial process length clarity.

story.hint: Setup takes under 2 minutes. Pick your favorite companion style to get started.

guard.reason: Adding a setup duration hint on the story screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint on high-conversion step (84.3%), matching historical modest gains (+0.5%).

candidates.title: waiting_pet_launch_notification
candidates.change: Enable optional desktop notifications when the pet setup finishes during long wait times.
candidates.why: High median wait time (201s) leads users to navigate away before the desktop pet appears.

waiting.hint: We'll send a desktop notification as soon as your pet lands on your screen!

guard.reason: Enabling optional notifications for the waiting screen step is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median wait time (201s) with low implementation cost and positive historical notification trends.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps consistently hurt performance across multiple tests, triggering guardrail rollbacks.
Finish screen layout changes consistently degraded performance across multiple tests.
Sign-in redesigns consistently hurt performance, resulting in significant losses and no winning tests.
Sign-in hints, adoption new screens, and home wait-info features proved helpful by driving multiple winning tests, though most home wait-info tests showed no clear effect.
Predictions were systematically too optimistic for failing changes and guardrail rollbacks.
Predictions systematically underestimated the gains achieved by winning tests.
